title: Famulor connector
description: connectors/<slug>/connector.json — one app in Tools → Agent Connectors. Famulor assistants call it during voice calls, web chat, messaging and email; automations can use MCP connectors too.

slug.description: Stable id. Equals the folder name. Never rename it after merge.

version.description: Semantic version. Raise it with every change.

description.description: One or two sentences for the store card: what the assistant can do with this app.

kind.description: mcp = a remote MCP server. api_tool = one HTTPS endpoint the assistant calls.

maintainers.description: GitHub usernames that answer review questions and issues about this connector.

license.description: SPDX id of this folder's content, e.g. MIT.

docs_url.description: Public setup guide for Famulor users.

privacy_url.description: Privacy policy that covers the data the connector receives.

support.description: Where users get help: a support page or a mailto: address.

logo.description: Square logo in this folder: logo.svg or logo.png, at most 100 KB.

network.description: Every host the template calls, e.g. api.example.com or *.example.com.

setup_instructions.description: Shown in the install dialog: where the user finds each value.

config_schema.description: Fields of the install form. Their keys fill the {{key}} placeholders in template.

template.description: The tool Famulor creates on install. kind mcp: {type: mcp, url, headers?, oauth_mcp_url?} or {type: mcp_oauth, mcp_url}. kind api_tool: {type: api, name, description, method, url, ...}. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
